name: Local model
short_desc: Verified weights, sealed private inference on this box.
author: Humanity Labs
description: One-shot provisioner verifies pinned GGUF weights, then exits. Provider and loopback llama.cpp share one sealed offline container with read-only weights. Remote-machine mode disabled. No cloud fallback or conversation logging.

form_fields.label: Reviewed provider image (version@sha256)
form_fields.hint: Set after the reviewed source has been published; see RELEASE.md.

form_fields.label: Trusted owner proxy/controller IPs
form_fields.hint: Exact source IPs, comma separated, of an optional trusted owner-only proxy. Runtime's dedicated owned ingress edge is granted automatically. Never enter a shared network range. Proxy must enforce owner access; headers alone are not authentication.
